text:
Before: 6 maki pieces (salmon-cucumber-avocado roll), roughly 20-25 g each of rice plus fillings, so about 150-180 g total at around 40 kcal per piece = 240 kcal. One rice-paper roll with avocado and other fillings, about 100 g and 130 kcal. Soy sauce (about 15 g, 10 kcal) and wasabi. Drink: dark soda such as cola, about 250 ml and 100 kcal. The question asks about "food", but the drink probably counts as energy eaten.

After: all the maki is gone. About 1/3 of the rice-paper roll is left, plus a piece of avocado. Some soy sauce is left. The glass looks mostly empty with a little liquid, so the cola was mostly drunk.

Food eaten: maki 170 g, about 250 kcal. Roll: about 65 g eaten, about 90 kcal. Soy sauce: about 5 g, 3 kcal. Cola: about 230 g, about 95 kcal.

Total is about 440 kcal and 470 g with the drink. Without the drink it would be about 345 kcal and 240 g. I'll include the drink.
